keyEvents.text: Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Brighton and Hove Albion 1, Brentford 0. Diego Gómez (Brighton and Hove Albion) left footed shot from outside the box to the top left corner.
Chema Andrés (Brighton and Hove Albion) is shown the yellow card.
Igor Thiago (Brentford) is shown the red card for violent conduct.
Olivier Boscagli (Brighton and Hove Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Brighton and Hove Albion 2, Brentford 0. Pascal Groß (Brighton and Hove Albion) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the top right corner.
First Half ends, Brighton and Hove Albion 2, Brentford 0.
Substitution, Brentford. Yehor Yarmoliuk replaces Dango Ouattara.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Mats Wieffer replaces Chema Andrés.
Substitution, Brentford. Nathan Collins replaces Aaron Hickey.
Mats Wieffer (Brighton and Hove Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Brentford. El Hadji Malick Diouf replaces Keane Lewis-Potter.
Substitution, Brentford. Mathias Jensen replaces Mamadou Sangaré.
Lewis Dunk (Brighton and Hove Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Luka Vuskovic (Brighton and Hove Albion).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Kevin Schade (Brentford) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Brentford. Callum Wilson replaces Sepp van den Berg.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Jack Hinshelwood replaces Yasin Ayari.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Georginio Rutter replaces Charalampos Kostoulas.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Yankuba Minteh replaces Maxim De Cuyper.
Delay in match because of an injury Michael Kayode (Brentford).
Delay in match because of an injury Georginio Rutter (Brighton and Hove Albion).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Brighton and Hove Albion. Malick Yalcouyé replaces Diego Gómez.
Second Half ends, Brighton and Hove Albion 2, Brentford 0.
